newsitem.title: USA: Edison nuclear unit seen up at end of Feb.
newsitem.headline: Edison nuclear unit seen up at end of Feb.

text.p: The 1,070 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the San Onofre nuclear plant at San Clemente, Calif., is expected to restart between Feb 22 and 28, a spokesman for Southern California Edison Co said Friday.
The Edison International subsidiary is the majority owner and operator of the unit, which was shut for scheduled refueling on Nov 30, 1996.
The outage was extended for unplanned repairs to steam generators, but that work has finished, the spokesman said.

Unit 2 has entered preliminary restart mode, but will not connect with the power grid until later this month, after which is will take several more days to resume full capacity, the Edison spokesman said.
